description: S470: a server call as a cell's initializer (a cell not declared `(not to T)`) is a server call in a value position and is E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL (§13.7, §13.9.1). impl#1 refuses a waiting value in every RENDER position (interpolation, attribute value, derived formula, <each>/<match> head, engine derived= — server-fn/value-server-call-interp-neg now passes) but not in a cell initializer, which it evaluates once and awaits; here it still compiles at exit 0. This case replaces value-server-call-interp-neg as the pin of the carried gap.
rationale: §13.7 rule item 1 + §13.9.1: a cell with no `(not to T)` marker whose initializer waits keeps E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL. Server data reaches a cell through a `<request>` (§6.7.7) or a pending cell (§13.9).
